Instant petition has been filed for quashing the entire criminal proceeding including the summoning order dated 07.03.2022 passed in Complaint Case No.6040 of 2021 by learned Judicial Magistrate, Ranchi whereby prima facie case has been found to be made out under Sections 406, 420 & 504 of the Indian Penal Code against these petitioners and the co- accused Chandan Kumar.
2. The case of the complainant lies in narrow compass.
The complainant was in look out for a plot of land to start a poultry farm business.

The complainant and the accused persons were acquainted with each other and it is alleged that both these petitioners informed her that they know one Chandan Sahu who was inclined to sale the plot of land.
They also introduced Chandan Sahu (Accused No.1) to the complainant.
An agreement of sale was entered on 09.09.2015 between the complainant and Chandan Kumar for sale of three flats in the apartment under construction.
The complainant paid Rs.1,06,47,018/-, but the Flat was not sold and registered in favour of the complainant.

3. During enquiry, the statement of the complainant and two witnesses were recorded and on the basis of which the summoning order has been issued.
4.

It is submitted by learned counsel on behalf of petitioners that if the averments made in the Shiv Shankar Prasad Singh vs The State Of Jharkhand on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/180399809/
1 complaint and the statement of witnesses recorded in enquiry is accepted in its entirety, no offence as alleged will be made out.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The petitioners were not a party to the agreement of sale in any capacity nor they had been a witness to the said agreement of sale.
There was neither any promise on their part to execute the sale deed in favour of the complainant.
They have been impleaded in the case only for the reason that they had informed the complainant regarding availability of land and that co-accused Chandan Sahu was inclined to sale and dispose it.

5. No amount has been received by the petitioners in their Account therefore, the offence under Section 406 of the Indian Penal Code of criminal breach of trust shall not be made out in view of ratio laid down in Vijay Kumar Ghai & Others Versus State of West Bengal & Others; (2022) 7 SCC 124. Para 27-30 6.

entities.text: Vijay Kumar Ghai & Others Versus State of West Bengal & Others; (2022) 7 SCC 124
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: As far as Section 420 of the Indian Penal Code is concerned, the essence of offence is any inducement made on behalf of petitioners.
No inducement made on behalf of the accused.
The complaint does not disclose that there was any inducement on the part of these petitioners or they stood to make any wrongful gain out of the said transaction.
7. Learned Special P.P. assisted by learned counsel on behalf of the complainant have defended the impugned order.
It is submitted that it was the petitioner who had introduced the principal accused to the complainant under a criminal conspiracy.

8. After having considered the rival submission advanced on behalf of both sides, it is apparent that in the entire complaint petition, there is no averment that there was any inducement on the part of these petitioners or that they were beneficiaries directly or indirectly of agreement of sale between the complainant and the co-accused Chandan Sahu and therefore, they cannot be held liable for the failure of the agreement of sale between the parties in which the petitioners were not involved in any capacity.
It is not in dispute that they have not received any penny in their Account and entire payment was made to Chandan Sahu.

Under the circumstance, I find much force in the argument on behalf of petitioners that even if the averments made in the complaint petition and the statement made by the complainant and other witnesses are accepted in its entirety, no offence under Sections 406 or 420 the Indian Penal Code will be made out.
The impugned order along with entire criminal proceeding is set aside as far as these petitioners are concerned.
Criminal Miscellaneous Petition is allowed.
